claims.quote: Wild-caught Betta ideii from Indonesia, from the Betta unimaculata complex.
Betta ideii is a large paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from southern South Kalimantan and Pulau Laut, Indonesian Borneo.
Appears to be restricted to southern parts of the Indonesian province of Kalimantan Selatan (South Kalimantan), Borneo and Pulau Laut (Laut Island).
